title: Grateful Dead Live at Merramec Community College on 1970-05-14

ai_review.summary: High‑energy 1970 show with killer Schoolgirl and St. Stephen, captured on a soundboard that’s generally good but suffers from hiss and occasional tuning glitches.
ai_review.review: The concert is praised for its powerful setlist – highlights include “Schoolgirl,” “New Speedway,” the “China > Rider” jam and an inspired take on “St. Stephen.”  The soundboard source delivers a clear, lively mix despite a noticeable hiss, some drop‑outs and moments where the guitars wander out of tune, which divides listeners.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rave about the performance and setlist; a minority note serious recording flaws (hiss, cuts, tuning problems). The weighted average of show (70%) and sound quality (30%) yields a strong above‑average rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear with good balance; slight hiss throughout, occasional audible cuts and bass drop‑outs, plus noticeable tuning issues on songs like “China Cat” and “High Time.”

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set blends acoustic and electric sections, mirroring early‑70 shows; the acoustic banter is beloved by some, while others dislike it. The electric portion builds strong momentum with several peak jams, though occasional tuning problems interrupt the flow.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Ripping tone on a Sunburst Strat during “Schoolgirl” and noted pedal‑steel work in acoustic set; a few reviewers mention his vocals sounding off.
band_member_comments.Bob: Weir’s stage banter is highlighted as classic Dead humor; some note his guitar going out of tune on “China Cat” and “High Time,” making those moments harsh.
